title: Generic CLI adapter descriptor
description: The data a user supplies to run an existing command-line program as an Agent through the shared generic carrier. Declared here with the reference carrier in extensions/generic/; a host-side declarative runtime may adopt the same shape.

id.description: Namespaced Agent identity this adapter presents.

command.description: The program and its arguments, as an argv array. No shell, no templates, no command substitution.

input.description: How the invocation input reaches the command.

output.description: Every standard-output line is carried as a text event, newline included.

terminal.description: Exit 0 succeeded; non-zero failed; a signal failed with the signal named.

cancel.description: How a cancel request is honoured. `unsupported` is a complete answer.

cwd.description: Working directory for the command; relative paths resolve against the descriptor's directory. Defaults to the descriptor's directory.
